status: new finite-range comparison model, not a refit of the massless model
gamma_measure: dnu_ell(mu)=ell exp(-ell mu) dmu, mu>=0; s=1; normalized positive measure
composition_coupling_rule: each mediator shares d=(g,x,e) and material q=(1,Qme,Qem); integrated scalar force uses the same fixed measure for all sources
Earth_density_model: constant mass density within core and within mantle, separately normalized to the stated mass fractions
Earth_altitude_role: 710km representative satellite position supplied for comparison; not an orbit reconstruction
Sun_radius_role: supplied nominal radius scale multiplying BS05 radial coordinate
source_integration: mass-coordinate trapezoid with declared endpoint extension, same abundance/charge approximation as massless block
frozen_test_vectors: massless nominal double-source-null vector from source_null_results.json, x=t=.1
retune to null Earth satellite FORCE row and Sun 1AU FORCE row, normalize x=t=.1
test that retuned vector at Earth surface FORCE row
retune instead to Earth surface FORCE plus Sun FORCE, test satellite
annual_clock_rule: annual modulation due to source-distance variation probes radial derivative of potential, hence FORCE row, not static potential row
rank_policy: arbitrary precision determinant/third-row residual; report tiny magnitudes and conditioning, not an observational identification claim
empirical_role: no exclusion or instrumental claim; return point-test scalar response normalized to bare metric GM/r^2. Full ephemeris, extended test, and fit transfer not supplied.
